ns2:section.sectionText: What do our brains do when we read? How do the eyes inform us what the brain is doing? How do reading processes differ over the course of the life span, or in a foreign language, or in non-alphabetic orthographies, or in atypical populations? We'll read lots of primary literature and THE textbook on the psychology of reading (Rayner & Pollatsek). Lots of discussion, lots of opportunity to devise your own studies, lots of things to think about. Meets in room 389 Education Building. Same as EPSY 590 BE
